correctness.rationale: For J(n,2) and KG(n,2), distances to selected root edges are affine complements; a selected set is equidistant exactly when no two unselected root edges have complementary incidence signatures. This proves full-family coincidence n>=5. All 3-edge root graphs split into triangle, star, path, P3 disjoint K2, and three disjoint edges; explicit complementary witness edges exclude three types except n=5 P3 disjoint K2 and n=6 three-edge matching. Minima: n4 perfect matchings 3; n5 40; n6 35; n>=7 binom(n,3). Independent exhaustive incidence-signature census n4..9 corroborated.
residual_risks: Bounded finite experiments do not prove unrestricted quantification; proof reconstruction includes stated critical lemmas.
